design_doctrine.north_star: Command center first, reporting screen second.
visual_direction: warm industrial premium rather than cold enterprise blue
clear hierarchy with a left rail, hero status strip, and dense but readable work grid
high-contrast action cards with restrained accent color
surface live risk, readiness, and flow state before detail tables
workflow_alignment: CEO sees throughput, risk, schedule load, lead health, and campaign posture
Worker sees readiness, next jobs, blockers, and field capture flow
Marketing sees content queue, campaign posture, and proof-of-work media

first_pass_scope: selected card modernization without changing backend contracts

mission.goal: Redesign the Skylight Pros admin surface into a modern command center that feels operationally serious, visually distinctive, and aligned with real business workflow.
mission.positioning: Not a generic SaaS dashboard and not an AI chat shell. A field-and-office command surface for a premium skylight business.

success_criteria: Dashboard reads as one integrated operating surface.
Leadership, field, and marketing priorities are visible on first load.
No backend contract changes required for first pass.
Visual system is strong enough to extend across sub-pages later.
